coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Non-traded REIT subscription agreement printed as pictures: the investor completes sections 1 to 6, initials the representations (pages 6-8, a second Initials box for a co-owner), signs the W-9 certification on page 8 (co-owner beside) and optionally the electronic delivery consent on page 6; the broker-dealer's financial professional and branch manager complete and sign section 7 on page 5. No issuer acceptance block.

sure_per_page.2: sure; four short writing lines on the picture were missed by the measure and added
sure_per_page.3: sure of the places; the rows are cells with the caption at their foot; the custodian rows are completed by the investor (third party also right)
sure_per_page.4: sure of the places; whose the second Initials box is, is a judgement (co-investor)
sure_per_page.5: sure; the whole section is the broker-dealer's (third party)
sure_per_page.6: sure of the places; in each pair of Initials boxes the second is taken as the co-owner's (the section signs owner and co-owner)
sure_per_page.7: sure; 15 pairs of Initials boxes (14 state items, one with a second paragraph); second box of each pair taken as the co-owner's
sure_per_page.8: sure; the measure missed the pair of Initials for item y and the co-owner signature row, added

2: the logo; section headings; the empty documentation cells of the right column (the Other row's cell included); the bullet arrow before the note
3: section headings; the arrow bullets; the notes under the citizenship rows
4: the section heading and the paragraphs; the step headings
5: the certification paragraphs; the footnotes; the vertical divider between the two tick columns
6: the headings and paragraphs; the note under the email box
7: the item paragraphs; the empty framed band at the foot of the page
8: the item paragraphs and the W-9 certification text; the black band heading; the empty framed band at the foot of the page
12: the underline of the table heading in the instructions (not a blank)
9: miscellaneous terms and the payment and mailing box: printed information, no place
